en.title: Processing Orders and Shipping Fulfillment
en.excerpt: Step-by-step workflow for managing incoming buyer orders, updating fulfillment statuses, and attaching courier tracking waybills.
en.content:
Marketplace Order Lifecycle

When a buyer completes payment, orders transition through four stages: Paid > Processing > Shipped > Delivered / Completed.

Confirming & Packing Orders

Navigate to Seller Dashboard > Orders. Review the order items, buyer shipping address, and special notes. Click Process Order to notify the buyer that their equipment is being packed.

Attaching Courier Tracking Numbers

Once you hand the parcel to the courier (JNE, SiCepat, Pos Indonesia, etc.):

  1. Click Ship Order on the order detail page.
  2. Select the courier service and input the official Airway Bill (AWB) / Nomor Resi.
  3. The buyer instantly receives an in-app tracking update with the tracking number.

Delivery & Escrow Release

Once the courier confirms delivery or the buyer clicks Confirm Received, payment funds are released from platform escrow directly into your available seller wallet balance.
